content: Target is the classical monotone subsequence bound. For each position i define p_i as the maximum length of a strictly increasing subsequence ending at x_i and q_i analogously for strictly decreasing subsequences. If neither required subsequence exists, every pair (p_i,q_i) lies in {1,...,n}^2. For i<j, distinctness gives x_i<x_j or x_i>x_j; appending x_j respectively forces p_j>p_i or q_j>q_i, hence all pairs are distinct. This injects n^2+1 indices into n^2 pairs, contradiction.
